long_biography.plain_text:
Living aboard a sailing boat in France gave Charles “Charlie” Veale an early immersion in the sea before his family settled in Ibiza when he was eight. He later worked as a captain, turning practical experience with boats into the idea for a local charter company.

Veale and Alessandra Grisoni began with one boat. An outside investor brought two more vessels and financial backing in the second year, accelerating expansion. Veale's emphasis on winter maintenance and seasonal preparation became central to an operation that owns much of its fleet and employs in-house technical teams. He remains a founder and chief executive within the Smart Group, leading its brokerage and management operations.
